content:
The **Orbital Strike Beacon** is a weapon in *Fallout 76*.

The beacon acts as a guide for the Kovac-Muldoon Platform orbital platform, which will bombard the marked area after a short while with orbital strikes.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Fiber Optics (5) Gears (5) Steel (10) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned from script Complete One of Us | | Orbital Strike Beacon (1) | 

The Orbital Strike Beacon recipe is unlocked by completing the Enclave quest One of Us. One free beacon is added to the player character's inventory at no cost.
